'''S-03-38''' was a restricted security file regarding the [[Fire/Legends|fire]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Morjanssik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. The fire had started in a processor in the central shaft of Level 12, Sector B, but workers had reported to security services that the processor in question had been working perfectly and recently serviced.
